ResearchProjectDef.label: beam optics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turn electricity into a coherent beam and back again. Unlocks the beam emitter, receiver, mirror, safety shutter and beam window.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam splitting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Half-silvered optics and crystal prisms that split one beam into several and share the power between them. Unlocks the beam splitter and the beam prism.

ResearchProjectDef.label: coherent relays
ResearchProjectDef.description: Gather scattered beams, re-collimate them and fire them onward at full range. Unlocks the beam relay.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam capacitors
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bank beam power in the network itself, so it keeps flowing when emitters can't keep up. Unlocks the beam capacitor.
